classes.policy: Prefer exact equality. If a derived floating ratio or logarithm is unavoidable, use zero relative tolerance and an absolute tolerance near machine precision.
classes.notes: Do not loosen tolerance to accommodate a wrong counting convention.

classes.policy: Use hand-computable examples where possible. Exact representable values may use zero tolerance; otherwise use tight floating-point tolerance and audit the path/coupling as well as the scalar distance.
Compare invariant scientific quantities. Eigenfunction signs are arbitrary; near-tied eigenvectors should be compared as subspaces, not elementwise.

Require the same likelihood/estimand/specification and successful convergence. Compare fixed parameters, covariance/scale and objective or fitted means with explicit per-test tolerances. Do not use a loose universal tolerance.

applies_to: independent scientific libraries or separately assembled backend fits
classes.policy: Record backend/version, parameterization mapping and the quantity being compared. Tolerance must be justified per ledger entry because defaults, optimization and normalization can differ.

Do not use machine-precision equality. Predeclare sample size, seed, estimand and recovery criterion informed by stochastic variability. Simulation recovery is weaker evidence than analytical truth or independent equivalence.

For reproducibility under identical stored draws/seeds, compare deterministically where appropriate. For statistical agreement across independent draws, base acceptance on Monte Carlo error rather than arbitrary decimal-place matching.
